titre: Platform & Marketplace for Food Service Business Management
corps: A food service business management platform hired Memory Squared for custom software development. They're tasked with building a platform from scratch with e-commerce and marketplace functionalities. The team client was most impressed by the Memory Squared team's personal involvement in the project. The client described the collaboration as the vendor taking care of their entire business and not just the technology side of the project. The client submitted this review online. #### BACKGROUND **Please describe your company and your position there.** As a Sales and Marketing Manager I'm responsible for overseeing the project from a consumer's point of view. I'm working with the Memory Squared team on the marketing functionality and how to make the sales platform more user-friendly. I'm also discussing with the Memory Squared team how to balance the platform between maximum usability and efficiency for the users. #### OPPORTUNITY / CHALLENGE **For what projects/services did your company hire Memory Squared, and what were your goals?** Flambia is an innovative platform designed to revolutionize food service business management, but most importantly to allow consumers to order fully personalized food, accurately collect dietary data and achieve their goals. Memory Squared is the software house responsible for providing the development team to create and develop the platform from scratch as part of the partnership. While Flambia as an organization has great know-how in the areas of food production, marketing, and gastronomy management, we decided to use an external software house in the early stages of product development to provide us with expertise and a team, without closing the way to take over in-house development in the future. #### SOLUTION **How did you select this vendor and what were the deciding factors?** Memory Squared was recommended by one of our board members and they convinced us with a flexible team development model and the CEO's personal commitment. **Describe the scope of work in detail, including the project steps, key deliverables, and technologies used.** The platform consists of several areas and products, which were first identified and structured in the Product Discovery process. Then the overall architecture of the solution was designed and the technology stack was defined. Within 2 months of the project's launch, two dedicated teams were built, working in parallel - one on ERP+e-commerce functionalities and the other on Marketplace functionalities. To speed up the creation of the MVP, the UX/UI work took place in parallel with the initial development work. At the time of writing the review, we have MVP solutions in place in both areas. Further development is provided in scrum-based sprints. The teams are well-communicated with each other, and project management is entirely on the Memory Squared side with ongoing reporting of progress and constant backlog modelling typical for young products. **How many people from the vendor's team worked with you, and what were their positions?** 2 design and development teams, 5 specialists in each (Designer, Fullstack / Frontend / Backend / Mobile Developers), plus PM. #### RESULTS & FEEDBACK **Can you share any measurable outcomes of the project or general feedback about the deliverables?** 2 interconnected, dedicated development teams were put in place and integrated into our organizational structure in about 2 months. 2 production deployments, on 2 platforms each (web + hybrid mobile) delivered in a total time of 7 months. **Describe their project management style, including communication tools and timeliness.** Project management of the technology side (repository, codebase, code review, testing) was done on Memory Squared's side. For the business and organizational side the team was invited into our organizational tools - mostly ClickUp. For their needs, they offered to do custom integrations of their workflow with our system. **What did you find most impressive or unique about this company?** Super contact and personal involvement of the entire organization. They seem to take care not only of the technology side but of our entire business. **Are there any areas for improvement or something they could have done differently?** At this point, we have no objections

titre: Mobile App Design & Development for Family Archive Company

Please include a summary of key deliverables.** Memory Squared designed and developed Rooted Memories, a private family memory and genealogy app for iOS and Android. The project included the UX/UI design and development of the app, including interactive family trees, user profiles, invitations and account claiming, photo and memory uploads, galleries, captions and the backend needed to support it. Since the original MVP, I've continued working with Memory Squared to improve and expand the app. This has included performance improvements, account and media management, notifications, memory tagging, subscriptions and free trials, analytics and an admin panel. The main goal has been to turn my idea for Rooted Memories into a reliable, easy to use app that is ready for release on the App Store and Google Play, with a good base that I can continue adding to over time. #### RESULTS & FEEDBACK **What were the measurable outcomes from the project that demonstrate progress or success?** Successful beta release of the MVP, soon to be followed by a successful public launch. Key indicators so far have included completion of onboarding and phone OTP authentication, creation of family trees, adding members and relationships, photo/caption uploads, personal/family feeds and invited user participation. **Describe their project management. Did they deliver items on time? How did they respond to your needs?** They have been very easy to work with throughout the project. Communication has always been good, they respond well to feedback and have taken the time to understand what I'm trying to build as well as suggested improvements if I have gone slightly off track or needed assistance. Everything has been managed well and I've always felt involved in the process. Deadlines have constantly been met and delivered on or before agreed timelines. **What was your primary form of communication with Memory Squared?** * Virtual Meeting * Email or Messaging App **What did you find most impressive or unique about this company?** The thing that has impressed me most is how much they care about the product. They haven't blindly built what I ask for, they take the time to understand the idea and will suggest better ways of doing things when they see them. It feels like they want the app to succeed, rather than it just being a ticket order. **Are there any areas for improvement or something Memory Squared could have done differently?** Nothing comes to mind. There have obviously been small issues and changes along the way, which you'd expect with any project, but whenever something has come up they've been quick to sort it. Overall I've been very happy with how they've handled the project. This has been my first project and I've been surprised at how easy the process has been made for me throughout.

titre: Custom Software Development & UX/UI Design for AI Company

We decided to look for outside help for this project. #### SOLUTION **What was the scope of their involvement?** Memory Squared has helped us design and develop a new part of our platform. We started with a discovery phase, and there was a little bit of back-and-forth revising the scope. Once we finalized the scope, we had a kickoff meeting with their development team and our development team. From there, we've let Memory Squared do their thing. We've provided them with a document outlining the functionalities we want in the workflow builder. Memory Squared has built a workflow studio that allows customers to set up automations related to the communications we help transact. It also serves as a platform to facilitate self-serve integrations. For this project, Memory Squared has called our existing APIs. The key technologies they've used include Java and RabbitMQ. **What is the team composition?** We've worked with four people: Mateusz, the CEO; Adam, the UX designer; Konrad, the frontend developer; and a backend developer. **How did you come to work with Memory Squared?** We were talking to other companies, but wanted to work with a smaller development company. I gave ChatGPT examples of companies I was chatting with and described the type of engagement I was looking for. ChatGPT recommended Memory Squared. **What is the status of this engagement?** We've been working with them since April 2025, and our relationship is ongoing. #### RESULTS & FEEDBACK **What evidence can you share that demonstrates the impact of the engagement?** We're still tweaking the workflow studio to make it production-ready. The platform is a bit complicated to set up, but it's working end-to-end. We've tested it, and it works. We still need to move some production customers onto it. Memory Squared has delivered all the functionalities we wanted. There have been some bugs, but nothing too significant. They've handled them extremely timely. **How did Memory Squared perform from a project management standpoint?** They've met deadlines and stayed on budget. It took them around a month to develop the workflow studio. Then, we were given a walkthrough when they had the final deliverable, and then there was a back-and-forth of any edits, leading to the final sign-off. We've shared a conference article with them and used Productive for project management. They contact us via Slack whenever they have questions. For design work, Adam and I exchange Loom videos. **What did you find most impressive about them?** Memory Squared has been super timely in prepping for the engagement. They've asked very engaged questions. Regarding feedback, they've been very flexible in what we do with them. **Are there any areas they could improve?** It would be nice to get more feedback as things are progressing. We have a structure where they can give us a heads-up when things go off track. Still, it would be good to have more updates on a weekly basis. However, this isn't critical. **Do you have any advice for potential customers?** Be prepared with what you want. Having a very long and detailed document explaining what we want to achieve has worked well for us. As long as you know what you want, the engagement will go perfectly.
